Participants: Wakeville High School students of all grades. Application Details: Submit entries in MP3 format only. Upload entries to our school website (file size limit: 1MB). [Exercise 01] Find inner strength and peace in our Movement in the Museum: Heart Centering Yoga session, where we practice the ancient art of yoga surrounded by fossils. Date and Time: Tuesday, May 19th from 5:45 pm to 6:30 pm. Location: Chesterfield Museum of Natural History. Classes: Two separate classes (beginner and intermediate) will be held at the same time — each led by a trained yoga instructor. The beginner class will include chairs for those who need them. Participation Fees: Museum Members: $5. Early Registration (Non-Members): $15. Day of Registration (Non-Members): $20. General Information: Participants must be 18 years or older and will be required to sign a participation agreement. Please bring your yoga mat and water as they are not provided. Register for the class online. Parking in the museum is free after 5:00 pm. Contact Information: If you have any questions, contact Grace Harrell (Education Outreach Coordinator, Chesterfield Museum of Natural History) by calling 305-349-6483.

Wednesday: Sports & Outdoor Games. Thursday: Music, Dance, & Drama. Program Highlights: All activities and materials are provided free of charge. The program is supervised by trained, experienced staff. Registration Deadline: April 3. Program Start Date: May 4. How to Register: Visit mapleelemschool.com and complete the online registration form. (Registration cannot be completed over the phone.)

[Exercise 03] Come to the 2026 Family Green Day and enjoy seasonal, environmentally-themed activities! Date: Tuesday, April 7. Time: 9:00 AM and 1:30 PM. *Each session lasts 2 hours and 30 minutes. Please select only one when booking. Location: Avioly Environmental Center. Tickets: Children aged 3 and over: $25. Children under 3: $12. Activities: 1. Other Information: Aimed primarily at 3-11 year olds, this event is enjoyable for the whole family! Frequently Asked Questions: 1. Do accompanying adults need tickets? – No!
